We already have an AI-based translation and quality assurance workflow, but we need a final human review to ensure clinical accuracy, correct veterinary terminology, and consistency with the original English content. Requirements: - Native or near-native German proficiency. - Strong knowledge of veterinary medicine and clinical terminology. - Excellent understanding of English. - Experience reviewing medic
